label: Approve incoming sessions
help: Password, local click, or both. An unset value also means both.

label: Accepted passwords
help: Temporary password, permanent password, or both. An unset value also means both.

label: LAN discovery
help: Allow this device to be discovered on the local network. Y enables and N disables; unset is enabled.

label: Direct IP access
help: Listen for direct IP connections. Y enables and N disables; unset is disabled. The port is a separate string option.

label: Keyboard and mouse
help: Allow keyboard and mouse control in incoming sessions. Y enables and N disables; unset is enabled.

label: Clipboard
help: Allow clipboard in incoming sessions. Y enables and N disables; unset is enabled.

label: File transfer
help: Allow incoming file transfer. Y enables and N disables; unset is enabled.

label: Audio
help: Allow audio in incoming sessions. Y enables and N disables; unset is enabled.

label: Remote restart
help: Allow a remote operator to restart this device. Y enables and N disables; unset is enabled.

label: Session recording
help: Allow an incoming session to be recorded. Y enables and N disables; unset is enabled.

label: TCP tunnelling
help: Allow TCP tunnelling through this device. Y enables and N disables; unset is enabled.
